reference_environment: External developer-only JDK 21 project; Minecraft 1.20.1 named JAR produced with official Mojang mappings and ForgeAutoRenamingTool. No Java sources, classes, project or runtime is bundled in MCL.
vanilla_method: Compile a package-local wrapper calling the actual OverworldBiomeBuilder.addBiomes, preserve every original parameter and its order, serialize Biome then Space fields as compact JSON.
registration_method: Normally compile public YCB CaveBiomeRegion/CaveBiomeRegionParameters/ConfigModule/BiomeModule and public TB Region/RegionType/ParameterUtils/ModifiedVanillaOverworldBuilder/RegionUtils against Minecraft 1.20.1. Minimal compile-only mod-global/config and annotation stubs supply IDs and fields. Two protected vanilla builder calls are routed through a package-local access wrapper; their algorithm is unchanged. Invoke Region.addBiomes(null, consumer) and serialize every ordered parameter.

registration_configs.name: changed
registration_configs.changes: Frosted Caves temperature [-0.25,-0.15]; Lost Caves depth [0.4,0.7]; Dripstone Caves temperature [0.2,0.8]

climate_method: Construct the actual Minecraft Climate.ParameterList from the default source-produced region. Query 10000 targets in order: first 7595 alternate each box's minimum/maximum coordinates, remainder use java.util.Random(0x5eed), nextInt(24001)-12000 for each axis. Preserve previous-leaf state across queries.
